verdict.rationale: The Model Aliases docs state the policy explicitly: `<modelname>` points to the latest stable version, `<modelname>-latest` points to the latest version, and pinned versioned model IDs sit alongside these moving aliases. GET /v1/models returns an `aliases` field for programmatic resolution, and dated migration guides cover lifecycle. One caveat to pinning: retired slugs automatically redirect to a different model (grok-4.3), so a pinned ID is not guaranteed to stay on its exact version forever. Missing for 10: a guarantee that pinned IDs never silently redirect at retirement, a concrete example of the versioned-ID naming format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
